name: artisan-glimmith-web
description: The Artisan of Glimmith — browser UI + WebAssembly solver (rsolver).

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../rsolver && cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/rsolver.wasm --target web --out-dir ../web/src/wasm
